license_source: The dataset page has no license statement. The Keras MNIST loader documentation (https://github.com/keras-team/keras/blob/master/keras/src/datasets/mnist.py) states: Yann LeCun and Corinna Cortes hold the copyright of MNIST dataset, which is a derivative work from original NIST datasets. MNIST dataset is made available under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0 license.
selection: first 10,000 official training images and labels; all 10,000 official test images and labels
format: raw bytes; images are 784 bytes each (28 rows of 28 pixels, row by row, 0 = white, 255 = black ink), stored back to back; labels are one byte (0-9) per image, in the same order
logbook: data/logbook.csv lists 20 four-digit readings; for each digit, in entry order, the first unused test image with that label (image numbers start at 1)
